features.title: Offering catalog schema v2 alongside v1
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01a.md: the v2 catalog validator (providers, permissionProfile, proofRefs, transports, workflow sha256) and the version-independent accessors providerImplementation, installEligible and nativeImplementationOf, with runtime.mjs PROFILES exported and imported, never copied. v1 validation and every OC-01 behavior stay unchanged. Do not change spec/offering-capabilities.json, install.sh, preflight semantics or any provider code.
acceptance: The production v1 catalog and its v2 form both validate; each listed v2 mutation is rejected with no input echoed and no hook run.
Accessors give identical answers for the v1 and v2 forms of all 46 offerings, and v2 answers come from providers.
loadOfferingCatalog, discoverOfferings and projectOfferingPreflight agree for the same offering in v1 and v2; readiness is never ready.

features.title: Shared Codex exec launcher
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02a.md: core/skills/native-runtime/codex-exec.mjs with codexExecArgs (always --ignore-user-config), runCodexExec (detached process group, SIGTERM then SIGKILL after the grace, timeout 124, abort 130, CODEX_THREAD_ID removed, 0600 logs) and classifyCodexExec (fixed codes). autobuild and the hunt runner are not modified; the test compares against them as a drift detector. No real codex, network or HOME.
acceptance: For equal inputs the shared args match autobuild and the hunt runner on the fixed flag subset and always include --ignore-user-config.
Stub executables prove timeout 124, abort 130, SIGKILL after the grace and no surviving descendant.
Classification yields only the fixed codes, with PROVIDER_REFUSAL non-retryable, and CODEX_THREAD_ID never reaches the child.

features.title: Generic durable checkpoint store
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02d.md: core/skills/native-runtime/checkpoint-store.mjs, createFileCheckpointStore({dir}) implementing exactly the reserve/settle/uncertain/close port runtime.mjs calls, with atomic 0600 per-call files in a 0700 directory and an exclusive lock that is never auto-broken. Held calls stay terminal (no reconcile command). runtime.mjs is not changed.
acceptance: A settled call replays the exact completion from a new store; prepared or uncertain calls return uncertain; a binding mismatch is CONFLICT.
Corrupt, truncated and read-only storage surface through the real runtime as CHECKPOINT_ERROR with zero provider calls.
A second store on the same directory is refused, a dead owner lock is never auto-broken, and close releases only its own lock.

features.title: Role file loader with skills inlining
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03c.md: core/skills/native-runtime/role-files.mjs with listRoleFiles, loadRoleFile and assembleRoleInstructions over core/agents, kit/agents and graphs/*/agents, the exact frontmatter key set, fail-closed parsing and referenced SKILL.md bodies inlined once after the role body. The hunt runner is not modified.
acceptance: Every shipped role file parses with the frontmatter key set found on disk.
Unknown keys, a missing closing delimiter, duplicate roles, dangling skills and unsafe names fail closed with fixed codes and no input echoed.
The hunter assembly inlines the bug-lenses body exactly once after the role body, and the role body equals the hunt runner's strip.

features.title: Production catalog converted to v2 with a drift guard
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01b.md: rewrite spec/offering-capabilities.json as v2 (same inventory, the pinned provider rows and three transports, workflow sha256, declared dependencies equal to the derived edges) and add checkCatalogDrift to core/skills/native-runtime/catalog.mjs, importing loadOfferingCatalog and role-files.mjs loadRoleFile, never copying. Change tests/native-catalog-v2.test.mjs only so productionV1 reads the OC-01 fixture. No change to install.sh, preflight, the validator, accessors or any SKILL.md; no supported value anywhere.
acceptance: The production catalog is v2 and valid with 46 offerings, 6 workflows, 46 assets and 4 fixed targets, the same inventory and derived values as the v1 snapshot, and every entrySha256, workflow sha256 and transport entry equal to the files on disk.

Declared dependencies are a superset of the edges derived from role skills frontmatter, skills/<name>/ mentions in entry SKILL.md and static core/skills imports; codex is partial only for autobuild and bughunt, and no provider row is supported.

checkCatalogDrift passes on the production root and, on a fixture root, reports a one-byte workflow change, each other drift and each undeclared edge with its fixed code, sorted, without writing anything.

features.title: Codex leaf provider on the NR-01 wire
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02b.md: core/skills/native-runtime/codex-provider.mjs with createCodexProvider (frozen {runLeaf}), sandboxForProfile, CODEX_PROVIDER and CODEX_PROVIDER_CODES. runLeaf writes the runtime wireSchema to --output-schema, runs one codex exec through CP-02a's codexExecArgs/runCodexExec/classifyCodexExec (imported, never copied; --ignore-user-config always), and returns the {json} wire from --output-last-message as an NR-02 envelope. audit-source-only and release-controlled are refused before spawn. runtime.mjs, schema.mjs, codex-exec.mjs, autobuild and hunt are not modified. No real codex, network or HOME.
acceptance: The --output-schema file equals the runtime wireSchema, and a {"json":...} fixture yields a returned envelope that the real runtime accepts and decodes.

Every failure, including refusal, timeout, no output, non-wire and over-1 MiB output, gives a failed envelope with a fixed code and matching receipt after one spawn, and runLeaf never rejects after validation.
audit-source-only and release-controlled give PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED with zero spawns, no dollar field is emitted, and the prompt never reaches argv, the envelope or a provider-written file.

features.title: Codex install plan from the catalog
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01c.md: core/skills/native-runtime/install-plan.mjs with installPlan({installationRoot, backend}) and its CLI (install-eligible offerings sorted by dest, transitive dependency sources checked, fixed codes), and install.sh --codex taking its targets, dest_of, --skip names and backup allow-check from one plan run. The installed set and Claude mode are unchanged; the catalog and tests/install-codex.test.mjs are not edited.
acceptance: install-plan prints exactly the two current dest<TAB>src lines for the repo, and tests/install-codex.test.mjs passes unchanged.
A fixture catalog's third eligible entry is linked once, honors --skip, and a conflict is backed up and restored by --uninstall, also under paths with spaces and colons.
A missing dependency source exits 2 with DEPENDENCY_MISSING, empty stdout and an untouched target, and uninstall never restores a manifest entry outside the plan.

features.title: Offering inspection and a provider-keyed preflight gate
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-01d.md: core/skills/native-runtime/inspect-offering.mjs with inspectOffering (nine fixed checks, drift only from catalog.mjs checkCatalogDrift, ready only with an injected probe, probe called at most once and only after every static check passes, probe timeout) and CLAUDE_ONLY_CONTROLS; and in preflight-cli.mjs make IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_CERTIFIED read providerImplementation(offering, backend) for v2 catalogs while v1 keeps today's rule. No CLI flag or output change, no model or effort table, no process started by the inspection itself, no catalog, accessor or install.sh change.
acceptance: An unavailable provider row, a missing binary, entry drift and a missing dependency each give unsupported with zero probe calls; a throwing probe gives unknown, and no probe never gives ready.

ready requires an injected probe that reports model, effort and concurrency supported (wiring proof), and each of the six Claude-only caps under codex gives unsupported with UNSUPPORTED_CONTROL and zero probe calls.
v1 preflight CLI cases are unchanged, v2 refusals are keyed on providers.<backend>, and offline inspection and CLI runs start no process (spawn spy and PATH stubs).

features.title: Role-to-profile table and Codex leaf selection
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02c.md: core/skills/native-runtime/codex-selection.mjs with ROLE_PROFILES, CODEX_REFUSED_WORKFLOWS and resolveLeaf, importing CODEX_PROVIDER and sandboxForProfile (CP-02b), codexExecArgs (CP-02a), autobuild codexModel and DOCTOR_EFFORTS, never copying; add the DOCTOR_EFFORTS export to core/skills/run-records/doctor.mjs. No change to runtime.mjs, the provider, the catalog, role files, autobuild or hunt.
acceptance: Every role in every catalog workflow row has exactly one profile row matching the role files: Edit or Write gives build-workspace, checker is the only other build-workspace role, and the runner has no profile.
Release and audit roles, any leaf of release-flow or security-audit-flow, and the hunt runner give INVALID_SELECTION through the real runtime with zero reserves and zero provider calls.

Models map through autobuild codexModel (sonnet, fable, haiku to gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna), an unmapped claude-* model or an effort outside DOCTOR_EFFORTS is refused with no echo, and the runtime's PROFILE_REFUSED still fires for a resolver that returns a refused profile.

features.title: Provider-neutral SKILL_DIR helper invocation
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03a.md: rewrite the fenced helper commands in core/skills/{backlog,findings,gtm-brief,verify}/SKILL.md to the pinned idiom "${SKILL_DIR:-${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}}/<helper>" with the pinned paragraph and no .claude path, and update exactly those four entrySha256 values in spec/offering-capabilities.json. No helper code, install.sh, catalog row or other SKILL.md changes.
acceptance: Every fenced helper command in the four SKILL.md files uses the pinned SKILL_DIR idiom with the documented fallback paragraph, and no file names a .claude path.

The documented commands give their documented exits from a Codex-layout symlink in a clean HOME with no .claude, and the same exits and verdicts as main's commands in a Claude layout; verify reports capture: direct only off Linux (D123).
The four entrySha256 values equal the edited SKILL.md bytes and checkCatalogDrift stays ok.

features.title: Native graph host library and CLI
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02e.md: add core/skills/native-runtime/graph-host.mjs exporting runGraphHost and the --args-file CLI. It takes workflow pins from the v2 catalog, refuses before creating anything, puts role instructions in front of each leaf prompt, uses the CP-02d store and its lock, and writes result.json. No catalog, workflow, role file, runtime, registry, provider, selection or store changes.
acceptance: A pin mismatch (REGISTRY_MISMATCH), a v1 catalog (CATALOG_NO_PINS), an unlisted workflow (UNKNOWN_WORKFLOW) and a codex-unavailable offering (OFFERING_UNSUPPORTED) each exit 2 with no checkpoint, no provider call and no run directory; a bad args file exits 1 with one JSON error line.

A harness-repair run with a fake provider writes result.json (0600) when the graph returns and exits 0 with the graph status, escalate included, only when both closes succeed; a close failure after the write exits 3 and leaves result.json in place; a provider throw or the runtime deadline exits 3 with no result.json, and a held run lock exits 4 and is never broken.
On resume a completed leaf replays with no provider call, an uncertain leaf is held with CHECKPOINT_UNCERTAIN, and a new invocation id starts fresh.

features.title: Reference-content closure
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03b.md: in spec/offering-capabilities.json add dev -> harness-review and verify, bughunt -> backlog, release-pr -> backlog (sorted), and GUIDANCE_ONLY under both providers of the seven shared-reference-contract rows. No SKILL.md, role, workflow, module or other catalog change.
acceptance: Every skills: name in a shipped role file resolves to a catalog entry offering whose SKILL.md is a regular file matching its entrySha256.
The six lenses in intake routing (ALWAYS plus SIGNALS) equal the files in core/skills/bug-lenses/lenses, the skill table, the hunt workflow lists and findings LENSES.

Declared dependencies cover child-workflow and role-body closure edges, and the reference rows stay non-supported and carry GUIDANCE_ONLY under both providers, while install-plan output and checkCatalogDrift stay unchanged.

features.title: harness-repair and dev-build through the native host on a fake codex
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02f.md: set dev's proofRefs in spec/offering-capabilities.json to ["cp-02f-host-wiring"] and change no other catalog byte (dev's codex row stays unavailable: its SKILL.md is Claude-only, so install.sh --codex must keep installing the same two skills). The frozen test drives the CP-02e host CLI on a fake codex for harness-repair and dev-build (nested QA), sweeps the schemas of all six graphs through the native runtime, and checks the drift guard. No module, workflow, role file, SKILL.md, install.sh or provider change. No real codex, claude, network or HOME.
acceptance: Through the host CLI on a fake codex, harness-repair runs exactly 3 spawns in graph order with the checker workspace-write and the reviewer and qa-auditor read-only, and every leaf gets exactly the args file's env.

dev-build with an approved plan makes no planner or advisor call, its nested QA leaves carry workflowPath [dev-build, harness-repair], the plan bytes reach the leaves verbatim, and a provider refusal escalates after one spawn, replays with zero spawns and never invokes claude.

A schema sweep over the six registered graphs reaches 36 of 39 nodes with no INVALID_SCHEMA and lists the 3 security-audit nodes as unproven; the drift guard passes and dev's proofRefs include cp-02f-host-wiring.

features.title: Checkpoint store operator API
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-05a.md: add checkpointDirOf, inspectCheckpoints, failHeldCheckpoint and breakCheckpointLock to core/skills/native-runtime/checkpoint-store.mjs, reusing its private row parse/read/write and lock take/release (never copied). createFileCheckpointStore and its four-method store stay unchanged. No retry, delete or adopt verb, no returned writer, no directory creation; runtime.mjs, graph-host.mjs and any CLI are not changed.
acceptance: inspectCheckpoints lists every row state sorted by callId with only the pinned binding fields, reports corrupt rows, stray names and the lock pid and token, and changes nothing even while a live store holds the lock.

failHeldCheckpoint turns a prepared or uncertain row into failed with the binding unchanged and a 0600 file, so a new store replays the exact completion and a rerun of harness-repair escalates with zero provider calls; terminal, unknown, corrupt, invalid and lock-held cases are refused with every file unchanged.

breakCheckpointLock removes a stale lock only for the matching token and a dead pid, refusing CONFIRM_MISMATCH, OWNER_UNKNOWN, OWNER_ALIVE and NOT_FOUND with the lock intact, while the store itself still refuses a stale lock with OWNER_BUSY.

features.title: Codex gets the strict leaf schema
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-02h.md: add strictOutputSchema to core/skills/native-runtime/schema.mjs (every KEYWORDS entry classified, checked at import) and change codex-provider.mjs to write JSON.stringify(strictOutputSchema(request.schema)) to --output-schema, read the output as one bare plain object through copyJSON and return wire {json: JSON.stringify(object)}, and settle an unsupported schema as failed SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED before any file or spawn (after PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED, before TIMEOUT). wireSchema is still checked against NR-01; runtime.mjs and decode are unchanged. Update tests/native-codex-provider.test.mjs to the new behavior. No real codex, network or HOME.
acceptance: strictOutputSchema over every schema reached by harness-repair, dev-build, blueprint-design and release-flow gives objects that all have additionalProperties false and required equal to their property keys in order, with no dropped keyword, the input unchanged and the result frozen; bughunt's min/max keywords are dropped without error, and each unsupported shape throws UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA.

The provider's schema file bytes equal JSON.stringify(strictOutputSchema(request.schema)) (0600); a bare valid object is returned as wire {json: JSON.stringify(object)}, the real runtime completes harness-repair in 3 leaves, and the live-smoke excerpt-as-array reply is returned, rejected by decode and escalated once.

Non-object, non-finite, invalid UTF-8, symlink, FIFO, over-1 MiB and stale outputs keep INVALID_WIRE/NO_OUTPUT, and an unsupported schema settles failed SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED with zero spawns, no file and no schema or prompt text in any envelope or error.

features.title: Provider-neutral skill paths in role bodies
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-03d.md: assembleRoleInstructions in core/skills/native-runtime/role-files.mjs rewrites the exact token ${PANDASTACK_SKILL_PATH:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/skills/<id>/<file>} to the regular file in the installation tree, fail closed; checker, fixer, implementer and advisor carry the token; body and skills[].body stay raw; tests/native-graph-host.test.mjs copies every skill-directory file. verify.sh, the hunt runner, the catalog and kit agent-memory lines are not modified.
acceptance: Checker, fixer and implementer instructions run bash "<root>/core/skills/verify/verify.sh", and no role of harness-repair, blueprint-design or dev-build has a Claude path in its instructions, while raw bodies keep the token and expand under bash and sh exactly as today.
Unknown skills, missing, symlinked or directory targets, duplicate skills and unsafe installation roots fail closed with existing codes and no path echoed; near-miss text is untouched.
Every shipped role assembles, the hunter still equals the runner strip plus bug-lenses, and the CP-03b mentions in raw bodies still resolve.

features.title: Blueprint state library
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-04a.md: graphs/blueprint/skills/blueprint/blueprint-state.mjs with the state dir from git --git-path, the five SKILL.md state files plus meta.json (0700 dir, 0600 atomic files), redactSecrets/redactJSON applied by initState and every writer, readers and validators that fail closed with fixed codes and no echo, designArgs/backlogArgs byte-equal to SKILL.md's two node -e commands, content-hash freshness, and readArgsFile. Import only node built-ins. Do not change SKILL.md, blueprint-design.js, write-docs.mjs, the catalog or any graph.
acceptance: Every pinned secret shape is replaced by its exact label in initState, writeState and writeRun output, while git SHAs, UUIDs, short key=value pairs, prefix mentions and non-strings are left unchanged, idempotently.
designArgs and backlogArgs are byte-equal to SKILL.md's two node -e commands over three fixture states, and backlogArgs refuses a run2.json that is not design-ready.
freshness follows its content-hash table, and malformed, truncated, wrongly typed, symlinked or FIFO files fail closed with fixed codes and no input echoed.

features.title: QA loop ledger rules as code
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-05c.md: graphs/qa/tool/qa-ledger.mjs (node builtins only, no git), the loop.md QA ledger rules as plain functions - readLedger/writeLedger (atomic 0600 rename), applyResult, workflowArgs, applyIdle/shouldStop, setBlockedOn - with constants equal to loop.md. loop.md, harness-repair.js, install.sh and the catalog are unchanged. No commit, notification, PR tending, bughunt or graph run.
acceptance: A missing ledger gives the loop.md default silently and an unparseable one gives it with LEDGER_UNPARSEABLE; missing blockedOn and idleRuns default to null and 0; writes are atomic renames at 0600 that never follow a symlink.

applyResult keeps the last 20 runs stamped as date -u +%FT%TZ, done clears stuckSigs, escalate adds a stuckSig once, other statuses are refused; workflowArgs gives {repo, base?, maxFixRounds (default 3, positive integers only), knownStuckSigs}.

idleRuns counts idle iterations and resets otherwise with the stop at 2, setBlockedOn notifies only on a changed line and clears silently, and the exported numbers and names equal loop.md and harness-repair.js.

features.title: Held-call reconcile CLI and shared failed envelope
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-05b.md: core/skills/native-runtime/completion.mjs failedCompletion({selection, code, invocationId}) and the CLI core/skills/native-runtime/graph-reconcile.mjs (list, fail, unlock) over CP-05a's checkpointDirOf, inspectCheckpoints, failHeldCheckpoint and breakCheckpointLock. W2-1: never spawn, never write a returned completion, never delete or rename a row (only .lock), never create a directory, never act while .lock is held or without the confirm token, never print prompt or completion text. No host, runtime, store or catalog change.
acceptance: After a host CLI run is SIGKILLed mid-leaf, list shows the lock and the prepared row without changing the run dir, unlock needs the right token and a dead pid, and a rerun is CHECKPOINT_UNCERTAIN with zero spawns.

fail needs a matching --confirm, refuses while any .lock is held and on returned, failed, corrupt or selection-less rows, and writes failed/OPERATOR_ABANDONED with the stored selection; the rerun then escalates with zero spawns and no claude call.
failedCompletion returns the exact NR-02 failed envelope, rejects bad input with INVALID_RUNTIME_INPUT, and replays through the real runtime as LEAF_FAILED.

features.title: Blueprint decision rules
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-04b.md: graphs/blueprint/skills/blueprint/blueprint-decisions.mjs with BLUEPRINT_DECISION_CODES, applyInterviewAnswers, applyGateAnswers and applyApprovalEdit (SKILL.md 3.4-3.5, 4.2/5.2 needs-human, 6.4). Read request.json, run1.json, state.json and the gate run through CP-04a's readers, write state.json only through CP-04a's writeState, then delete run3.json, run2.json and meta.json. Import only node built-ins and ./blueprint-state.mjs. Do not change SKILL.md, blueprint-design.js, write-docs.mjs, blueprint-state.mjs, the catalog or any graph.
acceptance: applyInterviewAnswers writes SKILL.md 3.5's state from run1.json: every asked question answered exactly once (duplicate, unknown and missing ids refused naming only the ids), option labels kept and free text redacted, preflight have by exact name with the rest owed, overrides as decisions that remove their assumption, gateRounds 0.

applyGateAnswers answers the pending fresh gate by G<k>: a decision id sets its answer, an assumption id becomes a decision with resolves [], about null takes the next unused D<n> after the highest D id, every note is "design gate", gateRounds rises by 1 and at 2 it refuses GATE_ROUNDS_EXHAUSTED; applyApprovalEdit adds an "approval edit" decision at a fresh backlog-ready run3.

Every applied answer is written through CP-04a's writeState and then deletes run2.json, run3.json and meta.json, while every refusal (malformed input, a wrong or stale run, an existing state) uses a fixed code, echoes no input and leaves the directory unchanged.

features.title: Blueprint approve CLI
features.description: Implement only spec/contracts/codex-parity-cp-04d.md: graphs/blueprint/skills/blueprint/blueprint-approve.mjs, a synchronous CLI `<show|approve> --args-file <abs>` importing only node built-ins, ./blueprint-state.mjs (CP-04a pinned names) and ./write-docs.mjs. show prints the fixed compact design and backlog report with approvalSha256 = sha256(run3.json); approve checks freshness, readiness, the exact hash, a clean index, a new integration/<app> branch and safe targets, makes the empty start commit in a repo with no commit, then switch -c, write-docs, git add -- the printed paths and commit, rolling back bytes, index, branch and HEAD on any failure before the commit, then checks the commit holds exactly the printed paths. Every git call is git -C <repo> with argv arrays. No model call, push, fetch or merge. Do not change write-docs.mjs, blueprint-state.mjs, SKILL.md, blueprint-design.js or the catalog.
acceptance: show prints the exact fixed-grammar report, redacted and single-lined, ending with approvalSha256 equal to sha256 of run3.json, using only read-only git calls; missing, malformed, stale or unready state, a bad app slug and a non-top-level repo each refuse with a fixed code.

approve with the shown hash puts HEAD on integration/<app> with one commit holding exactly the paths write-docs printed (the design doc, backlog.json and, when the design has knowledge items, knowledge-map.json), byte-equal to write-docs and checked against the commit with git diff-tree, with untracked and modified files, the original branch, remote refs and origin untouched, gh never run, and every git call git -C <repo>; a repo with no commit gets the empty start commit first.

A hash mismatch or a missing hash, stale design, unready run2, staged changes, an existing branch or an invalid target leaves the repo unchanged with exit 2, and a refused switch after the start commit in a repo with no commit is GIT_FAILED exit 2 with only that commit kept; write-docs refusing or a failing pre-commit hook rolls back to prior bytes, a clean index, no branch and the original HEAD (branch or detached) with exit 3; a failed rollback step is ROLLBACK_FAILED, exit 4; a successful pre-commit hook that stages other paths into the design commit is UNEXPECTED_COMMIT_PATHS, exit 4, with the commit left on integration/<app> and nothing rolled back.
